### DESCRIPTION (upstream)

**SpiderFoot** is an open source intelligence (OSINT) automation tool. It integrates with just about every data source available and utilises a range of methods for data analysis, making that data easy to navigate. SpiderFoot has an embedded web-server for providing a clean and intuitive web-based interface but can also be used completely via the command-line.  It's written in **Python 3** and **MIT-licensed**. - Web based UI or CLI - Over 200 modules (see below) - Python 3.7+ - YAML-configurable [correlation engine](https://github.com/smicallef/spiderfoot/tree/HEAD/correlations/README.md) with [37 pre-defined rules](/correlations) - CSV/JSON/GEXF export - API key export/import - SQLite back
